title: 1290 Super Adventure S (Classic Heritage)
description: Representing KTM's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the KTM 1290 Super Adventure S (Classic Heritage) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
